hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: A shared launch hook where each pool's rules (anti-snipe window, auto-burn, LP rewards, treasury fee, sell tax, exit-decay tax, sandwich guard, volatility fee, allowlist, wallet cap, liquidity lock) are configured once at pool creation and are immutable thereafter. Takes a fixed 0.20% platform fee on every swap in the paired token; additional rules can deduct up to 20% (plus an optional launch-window fee up to 25%) from swap output, with exact-output swaps blocked when any cut applies.
